routine_scope.definition: Complete synthetic R22 assembly required by B5: raw tables -> parsing/filtering -> MAS/HMS extraction -> A,C,y -> known-offset map -> 72 raw and A*theta identities.
routine_scope.note: The synthetic fixture has 149 equations (111 host + 37 calibrator + 1 intercept) and 39 parameters. It validates the complete R22 subsystem that generates the 72 constraints, not unrelated H0DN methods or the observed 255-row vector.

label: ESTUDO_DE_DESENHO_CONDICIONAL__NAO_E_CERTIFICADO
limitations: Validation is limited to the synthetic R22 subsystem and does not rebuild or inspect the observed 255-row vector.
Passing the fixtures proves the tested synthetic assembly path only; it does not prove observed centers, physical covariance, power, or admission of a variant.
No solver or estimator is part of B5 assembly validation; neither was called.
